neighbours.label: words expressing volition or deliberate agency: something done by choice, wilfully, voluntarily, or left up to someone
fire: Many of the residents remain in the old town by choice rather than necessity.
The referee said the defender had wilfully ignored the warning.
How long you keep the backup copies is entirely up to you.
The workers stayed late voluntarily to finish the shipment.
He deliberately left the gate open for the neighbour's dog.
Whether to attend the dinner is your own decision to make.
She chose of her own free will to give up the inheritance.
The company opted to recall the cars before any complaint arrived.
quiet: Many of the residents remain in the old town since the rents are low.
The referee said the defender had not heard the warning.
How long the backup copies last depends on the disk.
The workers stayed late because the shipment was delayed.
He left the gate open when the wind blew it loose.
The dinner will be held on Friday in the main hall.
She received the inheritance from an aunt in Lisbon.
The company recalled the cars after a fault was found.
